heading.title: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article46Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part II—Suits Relating to Contracts
Under the Indian Succession Act, 1925 (39 of 1925), section 360 or section 361, to compel a refund by a person to whom an executor or administrator has paid a legacy or distributed assets.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of the payment or distribution.
